title: Day 750: Woman Shot Inside Business at Barrancos Shopping Plaza in Culiacán
detail: A woman was shot inside a business at a commercial plaza in the Barrancos sector of southern Culiacán around 10:06 PM on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, at the intersection of Avenida Giovanni Zamudio and Antonio Nakayama, near a well-known shopping center. Witnesses reported hearing gunfire before emergency responders arrived. Red Cross paramedics treated her at the scene before transporting her to a hospital; her condition was not disclosed. State Police and Mexican Army personnel secured the perimeter while investigators worked the scene. No arrests have been reported.

title: Day 750: Man Dies After Being Shot Nine Times in Mazatlán's Casa Redonda Neighborhood
detail: A man was attacked by gunmen on Caracol Street in the Casa Redonda neighborhood of Mazatlán shortly after 3:00 PM on Wednesday, August 12, 2026. He suffered at least nine gunshot wounds. Civil Protection paramedics transported him to a private hospital, where he died around 5:00 PM the same day. The Sinaloa State Attorney General's Office (FGE) opened an intentional-homicide investigation. The killing came amid a sharp violence spike in Mazatlán tied to the Chapitos–Mayos territorial dispute over the port, which prompted the Navy to begin surging personnel into the city days later under 'Operación Sable.'

media.caption: Man shot nine times in Mazatlán's Casa Redonda neighborhood, August 12, 2026
